These entries apply the journal's four steps to the days covered in the
[case studies](case-studies.qmd): observation, mechanism, prediction, and
scoring.

::: {.callout-note title="Read this first" icon=false}
Every entry on this page was written in hindsight, after the outcome was
known. Each prediction is the one the mechanism would have implied on the
evening of that day, and the scoring shows whether it held and which link
broke. Because the outcomes were known, the results here are not a track
record and are excluded from the scored record. Forward-looking predictions,
published before their outcomes, are in the [Journal](index.qmd).
:::
